title: Safe upgrades, slices T06a–T06d: rehearsal, journaled rehearsal, admission of schema-preserving upgrades, first Mac move
goal: Deliver the upgrade mechanism up to admission of application upgrades that keep the schema version, and move the Mac service once by hand onto it
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; actual profiles, backups, credentials and deployment evidence remain private.
acceptance: T06a: reader contract and review-only rehearsal on a private backup copy (PR #257)
T06b: journaled rehearse step between fetch and checkout; a blocker ends the update as refused with the claim released (PR #258)
T06c: admission of application upgrades that descend from the installed revision, carry the reader entry and meet the Node range; forward migrations refused (PR #262)
T06d: one owner-run move of the Mac service to the new code, with a clean rehearsal (2026-11-11, running build 2a3448d)
validation: Merged CI of PR #257, #258 and #262; independent review of #257 and #262; owner-run rehearsal output (no blockers, schema 6, no forward migration) and running build 2a3448d
The joint independent review of T06b and T06c is T06e (F-005-T12)
escalation: Any destructive restore, changed ownership or unresolved physical/worker effects requires explicit reconciliation; general restore remains F-062

effort.basis: Owner-approved split of the original T06 (4–6 focused days) into lettered slices on 2026-11-11, after the work had been delivered as unplanned slices; slices e–h use free step numbers because step IDs are two digits. T06 now covers slices a–d, all done. It stays implemented until T06e's review, because T06b was never independently reviewed. Elapsed work was not measured. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one.
